change.from: if (!res.ok || !data.success || !data.reply) throw new Error(data.error || "답변을 확인하지 못했어요.");
change.to: if (!res.ok || !data.success || typeof data.reply !== "string" || !data.reply) throw new Error(data.error || "답변을 확인하지 못했어요.");

only_new_behavior: Require a nonempty string POST reply before acknowledging the send. Truthy object/number/boolean replies use the existing uncertain-send error/review state and preserve the question draft.
